reason: P0.5-08 integrates course code answering and independent automatic/show/hide block presentation through the existing single ephemeral EDIT-SYNC-01 document. TEACHING-PRESENTATION-01 1.0.0 supplies exact lesson recommendations, while SAVE2 blockWorkspace stores only the user display choice. Hidden blocks retain real Rust input/source mappings, identical full-submission teaching checks, invalid draft preservation, stale-run invalidation and reward idempotency. The existing twenty block kinds, six exercises and twenty-four tests, Rust/WASM build, C subset, EXEC/STEP/JUDGE/CONTENT/SAVE formats and 1000ms execution budget remain. The 36 reviewed files extend the prior 29 with preferences, the independent recommendation resource and responsive workbench/settings integration. Final-source original45+3+15+15 browser gates, all declared bidirectional scenarios, all seventeen presentation scenarios in three browsers and the complete frontend suite passed. Course expansion, unlocks, persistent edit history and the general custom-code workbench are excluded.
